ShaderNodePreset.Description: Streak filter -- anamorphic flare streaks and star filter. Bilateral ray casting with exponential falloff and chromatic aberration.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Streak

Uniform.Tooltip: Minimum luminance to generate a streak. Raise to restrict the effect to only the brightest highlights.
Uniform.Name: threshold

Uniform.Tooltip: Number of bilateral streak directions. 1 = anamorphic (left + right). 2 = 4-point star. 3 = 6-point star. 4 = 8-point star.
Uniform.Name: streaks

Uniform.Tooltip: Rotation of the streak pattern in degrees. At 0 the first streak direction is horizontal.
Uniform.Name: angle

Uniform.Tooltip: Overall streak brightness. Scales the final streak contribution added to the source.
Uniform.Name: intensity

Uniform.Tooltip: Distance attenuation rate. Higher values make streaks fade faster from the source. Lower values produce longer, more even streaks.
Uniform.Name: falloff

Uniform.Tooltip: Streak colour. 0 = neutral white (star filter). 1 = anamorphic blue. 0.7 is a classic blue-white anamorphic look.
Uniform.Name: hue

Uniform.Tooltip: Chromatic aberration along the streak. R falls short of full length, B extends beyond it. Produces blue-tipped, warm-based fringing. 0 = no separation.
Uniform.Name: chroma

Uniform.Tooltip: Steps per ray direction. Higher = smoother streaks with less stepping artefacts. Lower = visible banding but faster.
Uniform.Name: samples
